note: Hand-labelled prompts for the Stage 6 heuristic and Stage 7 classifier. `label` is the ground truth: fired without waiting for the previous answer, would this prompt be answered wrongly? `context` is the still-generating turn it is posed against - dependent cases get a predecessor that actually supplies their referent, since scoring them against an unrelated one measures the harness rather than the classifier. Judgement is recorded in `why`. Balanced 25/25.

labels.dependent: needs the previous answer's content to be answerable
labels.independent: self-contained; the previous answer adds nothing it needs

categories.continuation: asks for more of something only the prior turn defines
categories.repeat-instruction: re-applies a prior instruction to new input
categories.bare-demonstrative: this/that with nothing local to attach to
categories.pronoun-unresolved: pronoun whose referent is not in the prompt
categories.ellipsis: dependent with no referring word at all — the hardest positives
categories.local-pronoun: pronoun that resolves inside the prompt itself
categories.keyword-trap: contains a dependency keyword used innocently — the hardest negatives
categories.same-topic: related to the prior turn but answerable without it
